# 44i Digital
> White label digital marketing partner for TV and radio broadcasters, advertising agencies, publishers, and out-of-home groups. Based in Sioux Falls, South Dakota. 100% US-based fulfillment.

## What 44i Digital does
- Builds each partner a custom agency website for their market, under the partner's brand
- Fulfills digital campaigns (SEO/AEO, paid search, paid social, programmatic display and video, streaming TV/CTV, streaming audio, geofencing, CRM and event targeting, digital out-of-home, email, reputation, websites, creative) invisibly under the partner's brand
- Trains partner sales teams: weekly live sessions, in-market seminars, and Digital Certification
- Provides Fourge Insights, a proprietary digital audit AEs present in the first client meeting
- Assigns each partner an Account Director, Trainer, and Campaign Manager; joins client calls on request and provides a Senior Digital Strategist for large accounts

## Pricing
- Full details: https://www.44idigital.com/program/pricing/
- Partner Growth Program license: $299/month, month-to-month
- Certified Partner rate: $149/month when 100% of sellers hold Digital Certification
- Media priced wholesale, separately
- Revenue guarantee: license refunded if the program does not produce revenue for partners who complete it

## Partner Growth Program
- [44i Digital Partner Growth Program](https://www.44idigital.com/program/): The Partner Growth Program: your agency site, Fourge Insights audits, a dedicated team, weekly training and Digital Certification in one $299-a-month license.
- [44i Digital Pricing: $299 License, $149 Certified Rate](https://www.44idigital.com/program/pricing/): One $299-a-month license covers your agency site, Fourge Insights, training, Digital Certification and a dedicated team. $149 a month once every seller is certified.
- [Fourge Insights: The Advertiser Audit for Your AEs](https://www.44idigital.com/program/fourge-insights/): Fourge Insights is 44i Digital's proprietary digital audit: a branded report on an advertiser's website, search visibility, listings, reviews and paid spend.
- [Digital Certification for Media Sellers](https://www.44idigital.com/program/digital-certification/): Digital Certification is 44i Digital's training track for broadcast, agency and publisher sellers: weekly live sessions, in-market seminars and an AE credential.
- [The 44i Digital Revenue Guarantee](https://www.44idigital.com/program/guarantee/): Follow the Partner Growth Program; if it isn't producing digital revenue, 44i Digital refunds your license fee. A refund, not a credit, in writing.
- [Why 44i Digital](https://www.44idigital.com/why-44i): The only white label digital partner with a written revenue guarantee. One $299 license covers your agency site, Fourge Insights, certification and a team.
- [Book a Demo](https://www.44idigital.com/book-a-demo): A 30-minute call. See a live Fourge Insights audit on one of your advertisers and a preview of your agency site. No commitment.

## Who we serve
- [Broadcasters, Agencies, Publishers & OOH](https://www.44idigital.com/who-we-serve/): White label digital for four kinds of media companies: TV and radio broadcasters, advertising agencies, publishers and newsrooms, and out-of-home operators.
- [White Label Digital for TV & Radio Stations](https://www.44idigital.com/who-we-serve/tv-radio/): White label digital for TV and radio: your station's own agency site, Fourge Insights audits, Digital Certification for AEs and fulfillment under your brand.
- [White Label Digital for Advertising Agencies](https://www.44idigital.com/who-we-serve/agencies/): Fill every digital gap invisibly: a digital division under your agency's brand, Fourge Insights audits, US-based fulfillment and media buying for $299 a month.
- [White Label Digital for Publishers & Newsrooms](https://www.44idigital.com/who-we-serve/publishers/): Turn your sales team into a digital agency: a custom agency site, Fourge Insights, Digital Certification and US-based fulfillment under your masthead.
- [White Label Digital for Out-of-Home Operators](https://www.44idigital.com/who-we-serve/ooh/): Sell digital alongside your boards: an agency site, digital out-of-home, geofencing, Fourge Insights and Digital Certification under your brand for $299 a month.

## Services
- [White Label Digital Marketing Services](https://www.44idigital.com/services/): SEO, paid search, social, streaming TV, geofencing, digital out-of-home, creative and web development: every tactic your clients want, under your brand.
- [White Label Content Marketing Services](https://www.44idigital.com/services/content-marketing/): The walls: social media management, email marketing, reputation management and local listings — content that keeps customers close, under your brand.
- [White Label Reputation Management](https://www.44idigital.com/services/content-marketing/reputation-management/): White label reputation management: review monitoring and response, review generation and listing consistency across Google and major directories, under your brand.
- [White Label Creative Services](https://www.44idigital.com/services/creative/): In-house creative under your brand: display and social ad sets, landing pages, logos and brand systems, copywriting, motion graphics and pre-roll video ads.
- [White Label Online Visibility Services](https://www.44idigital.com/services/online-visibility/): The foundation tier: websites, SEO/AEO, Google Business Profile, listings, landing pages, chat and Onsite Lead Gen — fulfilled under your brand by 44i Digital.
- [White Label Onsite Lead Gen](https://www.44idigital.com/services/online-visibility/onsite-lead-gen/): White label Onsite Lead Gen: identify the businesses and households already visiting your client's website and turn anonymous traffic into named prospects.
- [White Label SEO & AEO Services](https://www.44idigital.com/services/online-visibility/seo-aeo/): White label SEO and AEO: technical fixes, content, listings and structured data that get local advertisers found in Google and cited in AI answers.
- [White Label Website Development](https://www.44idigital.com/services/online-visibility/website/): White label website design and development: fast, mobile-first, ADA-conscious sites from one-pagers to e-commerce — built in Sioux Falls and sold under your brand.
- [White Label Targeted Digital Advertising](https://www.44idigital.com/services/targeted-digital/): The roof: paid search, social ads, programmatic display and video, streaming TV, geofencing, CRM and event targeting — every campaign reportable to foot traffic.
- [White Label Digital Out-of-Home (DOOH)](https://www.44idigital.com/services/targeted-digital/digital-out-of-home/): White label programmatic DOOH: digital billboards and venue screens bought like digital — geo-targeted, dayparted, and reported with the rest of the campaign.
- [White Label Geofencing & Location Targeting](https://www.44idigital.com/services/targeted-digital/location-targeting/): Geofencing, event targeting, CRM list matching and household targeting under your brand, with offline visit reporting on every campaign.
- [White Label Paid Social Advertising](https://www.44idigital.com/services/targeted-digital/paid-social/): White label paid social on Facebook & Instagram, TikTok, Snapchat and LinkedIn — strategy, creative, targeting, optimization and reporting under your brand.
- [White Label Paid Search Management](https://www.44idigital.com/services/targeted-digital/search-engine-marketing/): White label Google Ads and Microsoft Ads management: keyword strategy, ad copy, landing pages and conversion tracking, fulfilled in Sioux Falls under your brand.
- [White Label Streaming TV & CTV Advertising](https://www.44idigital.com/services/targeted-digital/streaming-tv/): Fully managed streaming TV and CTV under your brand: Hulu, YouTube TV, Prime Video, Netflix and live sports, with offline visit reporting.
- [White Label Programmatic Display Advertising](https://www.44idigital.com/services/targeted-digital/targeted-display/): White label programmatic display: banner campaigns across millions of sites, audience-targeted and frequency-capped, with retargeting and dynamic creative.
